business: Bin Eid Advocates and Legal Consultants
summary: A Dubai and Sharjah advocates firm appears to lose enquiries to a menu typo, a free builder address and a contact page with no form.

findings.problem: The menu appears to read Legal Sevices.
findings.cost: A spelling error in the main menu of a law firm weakens trust.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Weebly address.
findings.cost: A free builder address makes an advocates firm look temporary.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a clean branded site.

findings.problem: The contact page appears to show only addresses and phone numbers, with no enquiry form.
findings.cost: Clients who want to leave details at night cannot do so.
findings.fix: A short enquiry form with matter type.

findings.problem: A WhatsApp number appears for the Sharjah office only, with the Dubai office listing a 600 number.
findings.cost: Dubai clients cannot message the Dubai office.
findings.fix: WhatsApp for the Dubai office too.

redesign: Enquiry form and WhatsApp for both offices.
